# Architecture

Technical ground truth for the Eat In / Takeaway VAT app. Binding for lifecycle agents; keep in sync with code in the same PR.

## Stack

- Laravel 13 (PHP 8.5), DDD layout: `app/Application` (HTTP, console), `app/Domain` (actions, services, data objects, enums), `app/Framework` (providers, exceptions). Webhook jobs live in `app/Jobs` (kyon147 `job_namespace`).
- Embedded admin: Inertia v2 + React + Polaris (`resources/js/src`).
- Shopify integration via `kyon147/laravel-shopify` and `visualsoft/vs-shopify-connector` (`ShopifyGraphQlService`, `AddTagsToOrder`, `AuthPos`, `UserSettingService`).

## Extensions (`extensions/`)

| Extension | Type / target | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `eat-in-cart-transform` | Function (Rust), `cart.transform.run` | For eat-in carts, `lineExpand`s each dynamic line into product + "Eat-in charge" component |
| `pos-eat-in-tile` | POS UI, `pos.home.tile.render` | Toggles the `_order_type` / `Order type` cart properties |
| `order-eat-in-block` | Admin UI, `admin.order-details.block.render` | Shows the order's eat-in VAT metafields |
| `main` | Theme app extension | Template scaffold only; not used by the eat-in feature (POS-only) |

UI extensions and functions target API `2026-07`. Each extension has a committed `shopify.extension.tomlsubst` plus per-environment TOMLs generated by `bin/build-shopify-config.sh`.

## Data contract

- Cart attribute `_order_type` (`eat_in` | `takeaway`) is the source of truth; `Order type` is the visible copy for receipts. Missing → shop default (`CustomSettingsData::$defaultOrderType`, app-installation metafield `settings`).
- Product metafields `vat.behaviour` (`standard` | `zero` | `dynamic`) and optional `vat.eat_in_uplift_percent`.
- Eat-in charge product: SKU `EAT-IN-CHARGE`, untaxed, created by `EatInSetupService`.
- Cart Transform config metafield `$app:eat-in.config` (charge variant ID, default uplift %, default order type).
- Order metafields (`$app`): `order_type`, `eat_in_total` (money), `zero_rated_total` (money), `vat_breakdown` (json). Orders are tagged `Eat In` / `Takeaway`.

## Routes and webhooks

- Admin (`/app`, `verify.shopify`): `/reports`, `/reports/export` (CSV), plus template routes.
- POS API: `GET /api/pos/config` (`auth.pos` → connector `AuthPos`).
- Webhooks (`shopify.app.toml.envsubst`, generic `/webhook`): `orders/create` → `OrdersCreateJob`, `refunds/create` → `RefundsCreateJob`; both dispatch `ProcessOrderVatJob`.
- On install: `AppInstalledEvent` → `SetUpEatInOnAppInstalledListener` (registered in `config/shopify-app.php` `listen`) → `SetUpEatInJob` (idempotent provisioning). Command: `eat-in:backfill-orders` (scheduled daily 03:00).

## Non-negotiables

- Reporting reads Shopify orders live via GraphQL (`OrderReportService`); the app database does not store order or VAT values (short-lived cache only).
- Never emulate VAT changes with discounts. Dynamic products are untaxed in Shopify; the eat-in uplift is a separate charge component.
- All Shopify GraphQL goes through `ShopifyGraphQlService` in a Domain service.
- Required scopes: `read_orders`, `write_orders`, `read_all_orders`, `read_products`, `write_products`, `read_customers`, `read_cart_transforms`, `write_cart_transforms`, `read_publications`, `write_publications`.
